text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few weeks after the autumn Tenno
Sho...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
King Halo summons me to meet her at
the
racecourse.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: It's been a while since we've been here.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: No! That's not what I'm talking about!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
About a year ago, we came here for a
particular
purpose, remember?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
There you are, Trainer. Are you
prepared yet?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
We're about to go on a journey worthy
of a king,
one which ends in becoming
first-rate.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I said those words a year ago, right
before I set
off on a path completely of
my own making.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Not a path to gain everyone's approval,
but a
path for me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
And I've continued down it as a first-rate

Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that's right.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
But still... recently, something has been
bothering
me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: It's this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Ever since she stepped out, the crowd
has been
going wild! A fitting show of
enthusiasm for this
year's champion of
the Classics!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Isn't everyone a little too excited?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Don't say that! That just makes it worse!
choice_data_list: 君の時もこれくらい盛り上がってたけど
貴方の時もこれくらい盛り上がってたよ

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'm the one who won the Takamatsunomiya Kinen, the Sprinters Stakes, and the autumn Tenno Sho this year.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'm this year's star! I'm the one at the center of people's attention! I should be the one being praised and worshiped by everyone!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So, in short...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: No! Not more, I want it always!
choice_data_list: もっと注目されたいってこと？

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'm King Halo, the first-rate
Umamusume! The
only one playing the
leading role in my world
should be me!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
For as long as I continue on this path,
the
spotlight should be on me!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention on giving it up, not
even to
those who come after me!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's show everyone my
first-rate—
choice_data_list: じゃあ、まだまだ勝ちに行こうか
じゃあ、まだまだ勝ちに行こう

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Grrrr! You dummies! Don't interrupt me
with your
cheers!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh... I don't care who these new
racers are! I'll
beat them all!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
To start, I'll win the Arima Kinen, and
then—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume from the Race
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I wonder who will be the
Umamusume of the
Year.

text_block_list.name: Excited Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oh, me too! I also want to know who'll
be this
year's Decorated Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I just had a great idea. If I'm not
mistaken...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer. Did you hear?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
My mother announced her interest in
designing
signature racewear for future
URA Decorated
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
But for me, something like that is
nothing more
than a checkpoint down
the path I walk.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I have what it takes to receive that title
because
I'm a first-rate Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a title given to Umamusume who
have
contributed most to the Twinkle
Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's counted among the greatest honors
an
Umamusume can receive.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The end of my career?! Why would you
say
something so stupid?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to remain active my entire life!
Don't be
a simpleton!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like King Halo has no intention
of ever
retiring.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In that case, she has a lifetime ahead of
her
before she earns that title.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should run in the Arima Kinen
after all.
Hmm... If I do, then...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'd basically have to come up from the
bottom! In
fact, I think "King Halo
Makes the Impossible
Possible" would
be a perfect headline!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! If we're going to do this, I'll
need to start
practicing my dash!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Well, she really should focus on her
upcoming
races first, rather than those in
the distant future.
